title: Student Registration Feature Implementation
description: Enable student self-registration functionality in the PAF-IAST Library Management System
goal: Allow new students to register themselves in the system with proper validation and authentication
final_result: Students can access /register page, fill the form, and successfully create an account. The registration link is visible on the login page for non-admin users.
key_features: Zod schema validation for all fields
Success/error handling with proper user feedback
Navigation back to login page after registration
user_flow: Success: redirect to /login with success message
Error: display error message below form
